title: docs(skills): land the app-repo working principles in the published catalog
body:
Fixes #13848

Lands the objectstack half of the 2026-08-31 app-repo principles. The hotcrm half already landed (hotcrm PR 1438); this PR discharges the card's whole remaining range — the published-skills universal items and the pm-dispatch decision-analysis clause — so the card closes with it.

## ⛔ Human merge required — this PR raises five shrink-only token ceilings

Governed surface, draft only. The raise is `⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY` territory and is taken here because the ruling that authorizes it names this landing surface by name. Verbatim and untranslated, recorded on the card:

> 「元数据应用就应该是在平台的规范下，基于skills 写元数据，并且使用平台提供的os命令校验元数据的合法性，而不是重新造轮子。这个也应该进入 hotcrm 的规范，甚至是 objectstack 的skills」

and, for the escape-hatch ladder (same day):

> 「或者说 skills 应该说明，逃生仓是极端场景按照客户需求自定义的场景下才需要，应该尽量避免。」

The reviewer's call is whether 900 ceiling tokens is the right price for these principles. Everything else here is mechanical.

## Landing map — where each item went, and why

The card's spec rows are domain-scoped, and published skills are loaded per domain, so each rule sits where the reader is at the moment the mistake is available — not collected into one section a data-schema author never loads.

| Spec row | Rule | Landed in | Anchor |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | App is a simplified business implementation: metadata under the spec, authored from skills, checked with `os`; capability gaps go upstream | `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` | new section "The App / Platform Boundary" |
| 2 | Platform defect means wait for the fix — no workaround, no half-landing; blocked-by; verify the pin and re-run the repro before resuming | same section | same |
| 4 | A bad platform default is a default to fix | same section | same |
| 5 | Docs explain business concepts, not hand-copied machine inventories | `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` | Docs — Package Documentation, after the authoring rules |
| 7 | Invariant vs transition gate: `validations[]` vs `requiredWhen` / bounds | `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | the field-conditional-rule bullet list, beside `requiredWhen` |
| 8 | Blocking rests on a human judgement; no override escape hatch | `skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md` | Validation Properties — Severity Levels |
| 9 | Screen flow stays `runAs: 'user'`; elevated writes move into a `subflow` | `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | beside the existing `readonly` blockquote |
| 10 | A `runAs: 'system'` sweep pins an organization predicate; tenant column is platform-injected | same file | same |
| Principle 5 | The section ladder: derive, then group reference, then hand enumeration last | `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` | Record Presentation, beside "let the platform lay it out" |
| Clause ② | App-repo exception to the recommendation order | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md` | adjacent to the 四棱分歧推荐序 段 |

Row 9 corrects a real drift rather than only adding: the existing `readonly` blockquote says a flow maintaining a `readonly` field must run `runAs: 'system'`. True of the scheduled flow it was written for; read by an agent writing a **screen** flow it says "elevate the whole screen flow", which elevates every other write in it.

Principle 5 also required fixing the page that taught the rung it demotes: this file's two worked `sections` examples enumerated their members. Both now reference a declared group, which is what the ruling asks for and is also shorter.

## Budgets — before / after

Token ratchet (`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`), unit `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`:

| File | Tokens before | Tokens after | Growth | Ceiling before | Ceiling after | Raise |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` | 12704 | 12984 | +280 | 12705 | 12984 | +279 |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` | 25143 | 25445 | +302 | 25143 | 25445 | +302 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 13782 | 13892 | +110 | 13783 | 13892 | +109 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md` | 3024 | 3109 | +85 | 3024 | 3109 | +85 |
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | 12618 | 12768 | +150 | 12643 | 12768 | +125 |
| **Total** | | | **+927** | | | **+900** |

Growth exceeds the raise by 27 because three rows carried that much existing headroom, which is spent first. Whole shipped bundle: 186567 to 187494 tokens (+0.50 percent).

Paid down before raising: the only genuine deletion available was the two `sections` examples in the ui row, worth 13 tokens, and it is the fix the ruling asks for rather than a payment invented to fund the raise. Nothing else in these five files had text the new rules make redundant, so further funding would have meant deleting a live fact with no other home — the stop condition, not a budget.

The SKILL.md subtotal self-test pin shifts 118095 to 118910, exactly the 815 raised on the four SKILL.md rows (the fifth row is not a SKILL.md and correctly does not move it), so the id-strip's lowering claim keeps its original 80 tokens of slack. Same operation the 2026-08-27 pm-dispatch raise performed.

Line ratchet (`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`): `decision-analysis.md` stays **46 / 46 lines, no raise**. The new clause is funded entirely by reflowing two paragraphs with the gate's own `wrapLine`, which frees exactly two lines. Widest-table-row pin unchanged at 0.

## A regression this PR caused and fixed

The first commit put the authority block between the `SHRINK-ONLY` doc comment and `export const CEILINGS`, which pushed that testimony outside the 400-byte anchor window `check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs` searches around every `CEILINGS` mention. The farm-wide detector then classified the gate `excluded` instead of `marked` — MISCLASSIFIED, i.e. it reported that a gate had silently left the maintainer-only convention. Measured green on `origin/main` and red on the branch, so the regression was this PR's, not pre-existing. Second commit moves the block above the doc comment and records the constraint in place.

Worth noting for review: that gate is **not** in the family `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` derives for these paths. It was run because a ratchet edit is exactly what it polices.

## Verification

Gate union run after the final commit, at `fa2a2ef70`. Exit codes captured before any pipe (`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`); each verdict read from the gate's own printed line.

36 gates run: the 32 the dispatch-gates family derives for this changeset (asserted with `--repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`), plus `check:nul-bytes`, `check-skill-line-ratchet`, the token ratchet's `--self-test` (64 cases), and `check-ratchet-remedy-authority`.

- **34 green**, including `check:doc-authoring`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:role-word`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:nul-bytes`, both ratchets and both self-tests.
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` needed `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` built first; after building both it is green (22 record-scoped examples, 9 spec TSDoc examples, 14 field-level predicates, all clean).
- `check-test-completeness` is **NOT MEASURED** locally, by construction: it parses a test-run log, the derived family names it with no argument, and the gate itself prints that this branch is unreachable in CI and is not a red. CI is authoritative for it.

## Changeset

None, per the three immediate precedents for skills-only PRs on this surface (PRs 14001, 13972, 13891 — none carried one). `skip-changeset` label applied at PR open.

## Out of scope

No hotcrm files, no `content/docs/releases/`, no pm-dispatch SKILL.md main-file growth. The nav-item-type rows of card 13890 are a different card queued behind this one on the ui SKILL.md face and are not touched here.
